title: A joint overlap budget and an independent finite-block closure
statement: The literal F0 four-wave overlap at fixed relative amplitudes has gap >=(3/2)c times the physical fourth gradient moment at all phases, means and overall scales. Exact convolution includes both quartic interferences and all eight cubic targets. Finite shared-lattice 9^j mixtures with the triad retain gap >=c<|sum G|^4> with permitted independent block parameters/output rotations. The F0 cross inequality is rederived; no F_star certificate transfers by name. Arbitrary input-lattice rotations, infinite series and unrestricted networks remain excluded.
